observations: Black rectangular desk with dual-column metal legs typical of motorized sit-stand desks.
A control panel with up/down arrows and a numeric display is visible on the desk's front edge in photos 1 and 2.
Desk is staged with two monitors, a laptop, a keyboard, phone, and small decor items — these appear to be the seller's own equipment, not part of the sale.
A separate footrest/under-desk shelf is visible in all three photos.
No brand or model text is visible on the frame, motor housing, or control panel in any photo.
No tape measure or reference object is shown to confirm the stated 160cm length.
No close-up of the desktop surface edges or corners to assess wear/scratches.
No video or motion-blur shot showing the desk actually raising or lowering.

claims.evidence: Control panel with buttons/display is visible in photo 1 and 2, consistent with a motorized mechanism, but no clip shows it actually moving.
No load being placed on desk or stress test shown; frame looks sturdy but 'heavy duty' rating cannot be confirmed from photos.
No tape measure or reference object alongside desk in any photo.

Photo with a tape measure showing the 160cm length claim
Clear photos of the desktop surface with all personal items removed

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a motorized height-adjustable desk, but the core motorized claim and dimension are unverified from photos alone, so it must be priced at worst case (functionality and size unconfirmed) pending the listed proofs.
